About This Game

ODDSTABLE is a single-player, offline horse-racing odds roguelite built around reading incomplete information, committing to fixed prices, and surviving twelve races with virtual in-game coins.

Each race presents six horses drawn from a larger field. Compare public form, track conditions, fixed odds, and up to three pieces of private intel per horse. Decide what deserves your trust before the window closes.

Build up to three standard tickets, or stake everything on an exclusive ALL IN. Contracts can tighten those rules, cap your stake, demand a particular ticket structure, or forbid ALL IN entirely. Eight markets open across the tour: Win, Top Three, Head-to-Head, Last Place, First Two in Any Order, First Two in Exact Order, Comeback Winner, and First-and-Last.

Then watch the six-horse race unfold. Follow the live order into the final 100 metres and, when the margin is exceptionally close, a photo finish. At the Night Cashier, every locked price, contract modifier, and triggered charm is reconciled into one readable settlement.

Twenty-four underground contracts are spread across four invitation tiers—Visitor, Silver Seal, Gold Seal, and Black Gold. Between races, visit the backroom shop, reshape your charm collection, and choose how much risk to carry into the next three-race meeting. Complete the standard tour, or take on the Black Book tour for a more demanding route through the same twelve-race structure.

ODDSTABLE uses only virtual game coins. It contains no real-money betting, deposits, withdrawals, cash prizes, or in-game purchases.

CORE FEATURES


  • A complete twelve-race single-player tour, divided into four three-race meetings.
  • Six horses in every race, selected from a larger data-driven horse pool.
  • Fixed odds, public form, track information, and up to three private intel slots per horse.
  • Eight markets unlocked progressively across the tour.
  • Up to three standard tickets or one exclusive ALL IN, with stricter rules imposed by some contracts.
  • Animated races with live order, a true distance-based final 100 metres, and photo finishes for exceptionally close margins.
  • Twenty-four underground contracts across Visitor, Silver Seal, Gold Seal, and Black Gold invitation tiers.
  • Charms, readable ticket settlement, an underground shop, stage bankroll targets, failure states, and completion routes.
  • Standard and Black Book twelve-race tours.
  • Interface languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, and Korean.
  • Designed for offline play with local saves; no external AI service is used during gameplay.

NO REAL-MONEY GAMBLING NOTICE

ODDSTABLE is a fictional, single-player game played entirely with virtual in-game coins. It does not accept real-money bets, deposits, withdrawals, cash conversion, or cash prizes. It contains no in-game purchases. Its fixed odds and ticket systems are game mechanics and are not a gambling service or real-world racing prediction tool.

GENERATIVE AI DISCLOSURE

Generative AI tools were used during development to assist with portions of pre-generated artwork, textures, icons, promotional imagery, and localization drafts. All such content was reviewed, edited, selected, and integrated by the developer before release. The game does not connect to external AI services and does not generate AI content during gameplay.

AI Generated Content Disclosure

The developers describe how their game uses AI Generated Content like this:

Generative AI tools were used during development to create or assist with portions of the game's pre-generated visual artwork, including horse illustrations, environmental backgrounds, contract and item icons, decorative UI artwork, the game logo, and Steam store and library artwork. AI-assisted tools were also used to draft or refine portions of in-game text and localization.

All such materials were generated before release, then reviewed, selected, and edited by the developer, and are included in the game as fixed assets. No AI content is generated during gameplay, and the game does not connect to any external AI service.
